narration: You've got losing stocks right now and most investors just sit on them. But the IRS actually built you a legal shortcut — it turns those losses into real money back.
visual: Dark background. Three stock ticker cards (TSLA -22%, META -8%, NVDA -15%) reveal one by one in red. An animated arrow points down to a green 'TAX SAVINGS' badge that springs in.

narration: It's called tax-loss harvesting. Sell a loser and you can cancel out the taxes you owe on winning trades — dollar for dollar. Capital gains tax goes to zero.
visual: Light background. Two stock cards side by side: red LOSER card with downward chart line (-$4,200) and green WINNER card with upward chart line (+$4,200). Two arrows converge to a green 'CAPITAL GAINS TAX = $0' badge.

narration: Even better — no gains to offset? The IRS still lets you deduct three thousand dollars straight from your regular salary income. Every single year.
visual: Dark background. Left side: simplified IRS Form 1040 illustration with a highlighted green 'DEDUCTION: -$3,000' row. Right side: animated stack of five green money bills building upward, $3,000 label appears below.

narration: Lost more than three thousand? No problem. Those extra losses carry forward to future years and never expire — they just stack up until you've used every dollar.
visual: Light background. Three year rows (2024 lost -$8,000, 2025 used $3K carry fwd $2K, 2026 used $2K carry fwd $0) reveal sequentially. A green 'YOUR LOSSES NEVER EXPIRE' badge springs in below.

narration: One catch you need to know: the wash-sale rule. Sell a loser and buy that same stock back within 30 days — the IRS cancels your entire deduction. Wait 31 days to stay safe.
visual: Dark background. A 'SELL LOSING STOCK' card appears. Below it: a 31-day calendar grid where Day 30 shows a red X (Deduction VOIDED) and Day 31 shows a green checkmark (Deduction SAFE).

narration: Over thirty years, using this trick saves the average investor forty-seven thousand dollars. Check your portfolio today — your red positions are actually worth something.
visual: Light background. Large green counter animates up to $47,000. Below it: three portfolio rows (TSLA -22%, META -8%, NVDA -15%) each with a green 'HARVEST' button. A dark 'CHECK YOUR PORTFOLIO NOW' CTA badge springs in.
